decisions: Every file is generated and locked: assets.lock.json carries a recipe hash of the manifest and a sha256 per file, so 'the accent was changed in both places but the lit rasters were not rebuilt' and 'an image was replaced by hand' both fail assertion 1. Without it assertion 8 would hold two strings equal while the pixels stayed in the old colour.

The lit rasters ship from the approved lit masters (tab2-*-active.png, medal-active.png) and the script VERIFIES each against the ramp of the accent in assets.json, pixel by pixel (all 8 masters: 0 pixels off the ramp; equal alpha to the idle twin). The steel masters are not named in the manifest at all - an excluded name in the manifest fails the gate.
Variant heights are derived from the largest variant, so the gate's size check is an equality, not a tolerance.
The equipment roster is written in the gate (16 slugs) and compared with the backend migrations where they are on disk; a frontend-only checkout prints that it could not compare.
